claims.claim: llmgw version prints version, commit, and build time and exits 0
llmgw health probes local /health endpoint and exits 0 on success
the server exposes an unauthenticated GET /health endpoint returning HTTP 200 with status ok
the server exposes GET /v1/models returning model list
POST /v1/chat/completions answers a body that is not a Chat request with 422 and the OpenAI error envelope, whose type is invalid_request_error
POST /v1/responses answers a body that is not a Responses request with 422 and the OpenAI error envelope, whose type is invalid_request_error
POST /v1/messages answers a body that is not a Messages request with 422 in the Anthropic envelope, whose top-level type is error, where the OpenAI envelope has none
every /admin/api route requires administrator authentication, which LLMGW_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_API never disables, and refuses a caller without it with 401 Admin authentication required.
GET /console/ serves the console index embedded in the binary, titled LLM Gateway Console
GET /metrics answers 404 unless LLMGW_METRICS_TOKEN is set
